Joining SVS

Let’s find the right course for you

Medicine, dentistry or nursing—start with the course, then check the admission route and documents for your programme.

Ask the admissions team ↗

Explore your options

Medicine · MBBSUndergraduate medical education →Medicine · MD / MSPostgraduate medical training →Dentistry · BDS / MDSDental courses and college information →Nursing · UG / PGNursing courses and college information →

Before you join

  1. Choose your programme

    Read the course information and decide which college and level of study you are interested in.

  2. Check the admission notice

    Confirm the applicable eligibility, counselling route, dates and approved intake in the current programme notices.

    Notices & updates →

  3. Keep your documents ready

    For MBBS, use the 2026–27 documents and bonds list. Dental, nursing and postgraduate applicants should ask their college for the relevant checklist.

    MBBS documents & bonds · PDF ↓

  4. Plan your arrival

    Speak to your college about reporting instructions, hostel arrangements and the people to contact when you arrive.

    Student & hostel guide →

Questions before applying

Where can I find the current fees and seat details?

Ask the relevant college for its current fee notice and sanctioned intake. Check the applicable academic-year approval records before applying.

College contacts →
Are undergraduate and postgraduate courses available?

Explore MBBS and MD/MS in Medicine, BDS and MDS in Dentistry, and undergraduate and postgraduate Nursing programmes. Each course page explains the available options.

Browse courses →
Can I arrange hostel accommodation?

The colleges have hostel facilities. Contact your college for availability, fees and the arrangements applicable to your programme.

Hostel information →
How do I find the college?

The medical and nursing colleges are in Yenugonda, Mahabubnagar. The dental campus is at Appanapally. Use the college-specific directions on Contact Us.

Addresses & directions →
Whom should I ask if I am unsure?

Choose your college on the Contact Us form or call its office. Tell the team which programme you are interested in so they can direct your enquiry.

Ask a question →
